title: 2. Memory Layout — 核心区别

    <text x="940" y="112" text-anchor="middle" font-size="19" fill="#AABDB2">1012</text>
    <text x="940" y="151" text-anchor="middle" font-size="29" font-weight="bold" fill="#F0F4F1">40</text>
    <line x1="34" y1="206" x2="1066" y2="206" stroke="#303536" stroke-width="1.2"/>
    <text x="34" y="251" font-size="23" font-weight="bold" fill="#EDEFEF">Linked List — Logical Linked（逻辑连接）</text>
    <rect x="333" y="271" width="90" height="103" rx="6" fill="#0B0E0E" stroke="#44494B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="378" y="309" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" fill="#BBC2C6">8000</text>
    <text x="378" y="351" text-anchor="middle" font-size="29" font-weight="bold" fill="#EFF1F1">10</text>
    <rect x="448" y="271" width="90" height="103" rx="6" fill="#0B0E0E" stroke="#44494B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="493" y="309" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" fill="#BBC2C6">2500</text>
    <text x="493" y="351" text-anchor="middle" font-size="29" font-weight="bold" fill="#EFF1F1">20</text>
    <rect x="563" y="271" width="90" height="103" rx="6" fill="#0B0E0E" stroke="#44494B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="608" y="309" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" fill="#BBC2C6">9300</text>
    <text x="608" y="351" text-anchor="middle" font-size="29" font-weight="bold" fill="#EFF1F1">30</text>
    <rect x="678" y="271" width="90" height="103" rx="6" fill="#0B0E0E" stroke="#44494B" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="723" y="309" text-anchor="middle" font-size="18" fill="#BBC2C6">4600</text>
    <text x="723" y="351" text-anchor="middle" font-size="29" font-weight="bold" fill="#EFF1F1">40</text>
    <line x1="428" y1="323" x2="436" y2="323" stroke="#B6BEC1" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <polygon points="441,323 431,318 431,328" fill="#B6BEC1"/>
    <line x1="543" y1="323" x2="551" y2="323" stroke="#B6BEC1" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <polygon points="556,323 546,318 546,328" fill="#B6BEC1"/>
    <line x1="658" y1="323" x2="666" y2="323" stroke="#B6BEC1" stroke-width="2.2"/>
    <polygon points="671,323 661,318 661,328" fill="#B6BEC1"/>
    <text x="34" y="412" font-size="18" fill="#CCD2D1">Array：Memory 槽位连续；Linked List：Memory 地址无须按顺序排列，通过 Reference 连接</text>
  </g>
</svg>
